segments.name: pharmaceutical products
segments.description: Discovers, develops and commercializes oncology medicines, led by hematology and solid tumor therapies sold to patients worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one segment: pharmaceutical products.

revenueModel.text: Product distributors and patients pay for oncology medicines, while collaboration partners such as Amgen pay royalties and profit shares.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company is the principal for product sales to customers in the Collaboration Territory during the commercialization period and will recognize 100 % of net product revenue on these sales.

changes.text: In 2023 the company stopped sharing development costs for LUMAKRAS and prepared to terminate it from the Amgen collaboration.
changes.evidence: In connection with the Company's ongoing assessment of the Amgen Collaboration Agreement cost-share contributions, the Company determined that further investment in the development of LUMAKRAS ® was no longer commercially viable for the Company.
